title: Word Search II
goal: Solve Word Search II: Find all words from a dictionary in a 2D grid with adjacent traversal.
strategy: Find all words from a dictionary in a 2D grid with adjacent traversal.
inputRules: board must be a non-empty array of rows, e.g. [["a","b"],["c","d"]]
board rows must all be the same non-zero length
words must be an array of strings, e.g. ["oath","eat"]
